stack.title: One integration across the stack
stack.sub: SDP is the Foundation’s aggregation layer: one integration across custody, compliance, ramps, nodes, privacy and more. Pick the partner on your criteria. Switch without rebuilding.

aria.partners: Partner APIs: custody, compliance, ramps, nodes, wallets
aria.product: Your product: a wallet, checkout, payroll, treasury

pillars.intro: Three surfaces behind one API and one dashboard. Each is a product on its own; together they are the stack a finance team needs onchain.

issuance.title: Issuance
issuance.body: Launch a stablecoin, a tokenized deposit or a real-world asset on Token-2022, with permissioning and privacy set before mint.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Stablecoins and two hundred fiat currencies through one API: pay, request, recurring, batch and micro, on and off ramp.

markets.title: Markets
markets.body: Yield on idle balances from tokenized treasuries to curated DeFi, and atomic delivery-versus-payment against cash.
markets.imageLabel: Two legs of a trade settling together

network.intro: Solana settles in about four hundred milliseconds, for a fraction of a cent. SDP puts custody, compliance, ramps and nodes on top of it through one contract, so what took quarters to assemble is a call.
network.raceLabel: The same payment on four rails: Solana settles in under a second while the others take days

currencies.label: fiat currencies, on and off ramp

issuance.body: Mint, burn, freeze, pause, seize and screen. The lifecycle is part of the asset, under the authority you configured, every operation auditable.

payments.body: Move money in stablecoins or two hundred fiat currencies through the partners you chose. The policy looks at every payment before it moves, and the ledger says when it has.
payments.sandboxLink: Send a payment in the sandbox
payments.bubbleLabel: Payments of every kind, each one sent and settled

pay.name: Pay
pay.body: Send USDC to a wallet or pay out to a bank in local currency. Your policy checks every payment first.
pay.figure: Pay: a payment of 250 USDC to Jane Smith passes the policy and arrives in her wallet, or is paid out to her bank in USD.

request.name: Request
request.body: Share a link or a QR code, get paid in stablecoins and follow each request until it is final onchain.
request.figure: Request: a payment request for 120 USDC, shared as a QR code and a link, paid by the payer and tracked from processed to finalized.

recurring.name: Recurring
recurring.body: Set the amount and the schedule once. Payroll, subscriptions and vendor bills then go out on time.
recurring.figure: Recurring: a monthly schedule of 1,200 USDC runs by itself, each run ticked off as the next one comes up.

batch.name: Batch
batch.body: Pay thousands of people from one file or one API call, with a status you can track for every row.
batch.figure: Batch: the rows of a payout file are paid one after another, each one ticked as it settles.

micro.name: Micro
micro.body: Charge a thousandth of a dollar per API call. Solana fees keep even the smallest payment worth sending.
micro.figure: Micro: an agent wallet pays an API a thousandth of a dollar per call, call after call, every one settled.

deposit.name: Deposit
deposit.body: Customers top up a wallet by card or bank transfer and receive stablecoins through the ramp you chose.
deposit.figure: Deposit: a card payment goes up the ramp and arrives in the wallet as 500 USDC, the deposit received.

markets.body: Two strategies on one balance: tokenized treasuries for the floor, curated DeFi for the ceiling. And delivery-versus-payment, where the asset and the cash leave escrow together, or neither does.

chart.description: Chart of the yield on one balance over time. While the balance is idle it earns close to nothing. Once it is deployed, tokenized treasuries rise to about 4.5% a year and curated DeFi climbs to up to 8% a year by today.
chart.rateLabel: a year on idle balances, indicative

privacy.body: Turn privacy on per operation. Settlement stays onchain; balances, positions and payroll stay off the public ledger, through confidential balances, private channels and shielded rings.
privacy.bubbleLabel: What stays private: payments, issuance, markets, payroll, balances

interfaces.intro: REST for integrations, dashboard for ops, OpenAPI for agents. One public contract.
interfaces.modes: Ways to work with the platform

execute.title: Execute mode
execute.body: SDP constructs, signs and submits for server‑to‑server workflows.

prepare.title: Prepare mode
prepare.body: SDP returns an unsigned transaction for your HSM, multisig or wallet.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.body: Approvals, policies, activity and audit records, in one place.
